quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn Industrial Internet half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue RMB 557.86 billion, up 54.63% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 23.74 billion, up 95.99%. The company attributes revenue growth to sustained explosive AI compute demand, steadily rising share at major customers and strong cloud-service-provider business; orders and product value both grew.

quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn Industrial Internet half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Cloud computing segment revenue grew 75.7% YoY in H1 2026. Cloud-service-provider AI server revenue rose 2.3x YoY, GPU AI rack shipments rose 3.2x, ASIC AI rack shipments rose 3x and ASIC CPU server shipments rose 2.5x. The company covers whole-rack design, liquid cooling and power management, is developing next-generation AI platform products, accelerating new ASIC programs and adding new customers, and is strengthening in-house development and vertical integration of key liquid-cooling components.
quarterly_data.figure: Cloud revenue +75.7%; CSP AI server revenue +2.3x; GPU AI racks +3.2x; ASIC AI racks +3x; ASIC CPU servers +2.5x

quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn Industrial Internet half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Networking: data-center high-speed network revenue grew 1x YoY in H1 2026, 800G-and-above data-center switch shipments rose 1.4x and SuperNIC shipments rose 1.4x.
